patches.find: there is no monitor.py domain for this WIN — it appears in the dome WIN list but no automation touches it, so even the nominal test that would check the hardcoded value against a live fetch does not exist.
patches.replace: the dome DOES automate a redshift check — its live-power "Aetheric Redshift Scale" domain reports Predicted 4283 Mpc vs. Observed 4319 Mpc, Status PASS, sourced to the Virgo cluster (NED) — but 4283 Mpc is exactly c/H₀(70), the textbook Hubble radius. The automation checks a standard constant against an observation; passing it confirms transcription, not derivation.
patches.rationale: Curmudgeon c7 review (WIN-047.c7.json, 4 cycles pending c4-c7, defense_survives=4): categorical denial that no automation touches this WIN is factually contestable — the dome live-power dashboard runs an Aetheric Redshift Scale domain (raw-text/08-live-power.txt:236-237, Predicted 4283.0 Mpc, Observed 4319.0 Mpc, Virgo cluster NED, Status PASS) verified as automation on redshift subject matter. Applying curmudgeon preferred fix: flip the denial into evidence (4283 Mpc = c/H0(70), the automation checks a standard constant, confirming transcription not derivation) per the standing c4/c5/c6/c7 stronger_argument.
